source.stem:
One method of preventing the rusting of iron is to keep oxygen away from the surface of the metal.

Which way of rust prevention does not use this method?

options.text: connecting the iron to a more reactive metal

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Nitrogen is used to purify drinking water.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Every non-metal is essential in everyday life.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Only metals are important in everyday life.

intelligence.enrichment: Non-metals have important uses: oxygen is needed for breathing and survival, carbon is a building block of life forms and key components needed for growth and energy, nitrogen is used in fertilisers and supports plant growth, and chlorine is used in water purification. The roles of non-metals in living organisms, plant growth, and water purification explain why non-metals are essential in everyday life. The learner correctly applies this rule: Non-metals have important uses: oxygen is needed for breathing and survival, carbon is a building block of life forms and key components needed for growth and energy, nitrogen is used in fertilisers and supports plant growth, and chlorine is used in water purification. Useful substances are mainly visible metals in tools, so gases and less visible non-metals do not count as important.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: The world of metals and non-metals. The student must decide: When explaining everyday importance, decide that non-metals are essential even though many metals are visible in tools and technologies. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE.
